banner_text: Student project — not for financial or legal use.
short_warning: This is decision support, not proof of fraud and not an automatic claim decision.
full_warning: A false fraud flag can delay or wrongly investigate a genuine claimant. A missed fraud case can increase losses and make honest customers bear costs. A claims adjuster must review the evidence and record the final decision.
required_mitigations: Human adjuster makes the final decision.
Every prediction includes a plain-language reason.
The case file shows up to five comparable past claims.
The missed-fraud and unnecessary-investigation costs are editable.
Pay, review, and investigate use two editable probability thresholds.
Predicted probability is shown as confidence, not proof.
The model recommendation and adjuster decision are stored separately in the audit trail.
Only the supplied public/anonymised dataset is used in the demonstration.
No automatic claim denial or automatic fraud finding is allowed.
